changelog:
- Media Background Playback: Scoped pause guard with playlist/queue transition auto-tracking and graceful detached element handling.
- Privacy Gateway: Added support for HTTP(S) proxy verification with SSL tunneling and legacy proxy migration.
- Disposed Frame Race Fix: Handled Electron navigation frame disposal during cosmetic filter injection without crashing.
- Bundled Windows Tor Runtime: Integrated dedicated Tor daemon with geoip files and custom torrc on Windows x64.
- Launch Script Polish: Fixed directory resolution in run_browser.bat.
